paragraphs.text: Dellian Fel is a human planeswalker from Arcavios . He is a professor in Witherbloom College at Strixhaven University .

Dellian is a dark-skinned wizard with pointy ears. He is mysterious, macabre, debonair, surly, and dark-tempered, with a brusque curiosity. He is known to slink through the halls of the University at night with no explanation and to spend a lot of time around Archaics . His mysterious nature and habits have led to rumors among the students that he used to work for the Oriq and that he coordinated the Phyrexian Invasion . He is an old acquaintance of Kirol 's parents and is on a first-name basis with Oracle Jadzi . He knows sign language. His magic uses plants.

Long before 4565 AR , Fel was unable to save the woman he loved and swore an oath to fix his mistake. Fel became a professor at Witherbloom College and the youngest tenured professor in Strixhaven's history. He became a pioneer in necromantic studies — specifically the link between life and death. When he was discovered dead in his lab, his fellow faculty mourned his loss for about thirteen months, after which he rose from the grave. Why he returned with a Planeswalker's spark , and what happened to his soul during those thirteen months, is still a mystery he is trying to solve — as is the strange hunger now lurking in the back of his mind at all times.

He combed Titan's Grave for solutions to his plight, even refusing help from a daemogoth he deemed not powerful enough to help. He took particular interest in the Archaics , hoping that their relationship to nonlinear time could offer him a solution.

Some time after the New Phyrexian Invasion , Fel organized the usual field trip to Titan's Grave with the second-year students, including Lluwen and Tamira . Upon arriving at Jawdocks Landing, they were greeted by the Oracle Jadzi . During the first few days, Fel assigned the students to explore the surroundings of the Toadstool Copse and report back to him if they found anything worthy of his attention. When Lluwen returned and told the professor that he had seen Lumarets communicating, Fel argued that magic had nothing to do with it and told him to look elsewhere. During a class, Lluwen was reprimanded by the professor after Lluwen injured Ivarin , another student. Fel told Lluwen to control himself and ordered him to do something more productive with his time or never come back. Despite the harsh words, Fel went to look for the elf and found him emerging from a hole in the ground where the boy had accidentally fallen. He asked if he had anything to offer him, but Lluwen said no.

That night, Dellian spoke with Jadzi, who reprimanded him for using the students for his own ends. The two discussed the Archaics ' strange behavior, but Fel remarked that he had been unable to discuss his theory with Liliana Vess before her disappearance.
